about: Every In Our Time episode currently available to listen to free on the BBC programme pages: 45 to 55 minute discussions with academics on history, culture, philosophy, religion and science.
collected: Parsed all 114 pages of the 'Available now' list (www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b006qykl/episodes/player?page=1..114, titles and durations from its schema.org data) and all 43 pages of the full episode guide (/episodes/guide?page=1..43), then fetched each episode page for its title and long synopsis. The Culture, History, Philosophy, Religion and Science subject archives (p01drwny, p01dh5yg, p01f0vzr, p01gvqlg, p01gyd7j) now say 'This podcast collection is now unavailable' and list no episodes. Collected 2026-11-11.
